snippet.title: Test Drive Cycles (Dreamcast Prototype) | Hong Kong Track
snippet.description:
Turns out there are more tracks on the Test Drive Cycles prototype disc. With a bit of folder renaming trickery, I was able to load them. The Hong Kong Track is one of the nicer looking ones.
